name: B10-0156/2024 – After § 56 – Am 14
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2024 in Baku, Azerbaijan (COP29)
part_text: 56a. Deplores the fearmongering in the context of climate-related issues with the use of terms such as ‘climate catastrophe’, ‘climate apocalypse’ or ‘burning planet’;
